Chapter 139: Chapter 19 Star Domain Evolution Rankings, Founders’ Circle_2

Chapter 139: Chapter 19 Star Domain Evolution Rankings, Founders’ Circle_2

“`

“The Mysterious Yellow Evolutionary Path….”

After two or three months of comprehension, Lin Yuan had progressed to one-tenth of the First Tier Chapter of the Mysterious Yellow Evolutionary Path.

“What exactly is this evolutionary path? Even with my against-heaven’s understanding, I comprehend it so slowly. Other evolvers, even if ideally suited to cultivate this path, would find it as challenging as ascending to the heavens to fully comprehend it, right?”

Doubts surfaced in Lin Yuan’s heart.

“Could it be that comprehending this evolutionary path requires some specific method? Or some sort of auxiliary means, an item?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself in silence.

...

The Chikun Star Lord had not provided him with a detailed introduction to the Mysterious Yellow Evolutionary Path, saying only to retreat for a while and discuss it after coming out.

“Stop the comprehension for now.”

“Integrate the Martial Tao evolutionary path.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts. Now that he was at the Fourth Rank twelve segments, essentially at the end of the Fourth Rank domain, he had the confidence to organize the ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’ of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.

Reviewing the path he had taken was very helpful for Lin Yuan. With his against-heaven’s understanding, new inspiration burst forth every moment.

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes again.

“It’s about time.”

Lin Yuan let out a light breath.

The ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’ of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path was essentially ready.

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan connected to the Goddess of Wisdom, intending to upload the ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’.

As the disciple of the Star Lord and the Peak Master of the Red Kun lineage’s Thirteen Peaks, Lin Yuan had not given up on publishing subsequent evolutionary paths.

Firstly, not only was there income from the merit points, but also a sizable share of the revenue. Countless citizens of the Human Alliance, with each purchase of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path, Lin Yuan would receive a thirty percent cut.

This income streamed in continuously and would increase as the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path rose to higher levels.

Secondly, as Lin Yuan joined the Red Kun lineage and accessed more information, he realized that publicizing and spreading his own evolutionary path seemed to have a deeper meaning.

Take the ‘Ancient Gods’ Evolution Path as an example.

The ‘Ancient Gods’ in the depths of the stars have existed since the beginning of the universe.

They exist aloof, without any ties to a race, enjoying freedom.

Despite this, these ‘Ancient Gods’ still spread the ‘Ancient Gods’ Evolution Path that mimics themselves.

The official explanation given by the Human Alliance is that the evolvers of the ‘Ancient Gods’ Evolution Path, once deeply cultivated, may become vessels for the descent of those ‘Ancient Gods’.

But how significant could such a weak vessel really be to an ‘Ancient God’?

Regardless, even the ‘Ancient Gods’ are striving to disseminate their Evolution Paths.

Lin Yuan continued to refine the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path to broaden its reach. To say it had no benefits would be incorrect, but it definitively had no drawbacks.

Whirr!

As Lin Yuan swiftly uploaded the content of the ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’.

In a Mysterious Space countless light-years away from Canglan Star.

Huge screens flickered rapidly and colossal computational power frenetically assessed and extrapolated the value of the ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’ of the Martial Arts Evolution System.

The Fourth Rank Chapter uploaded by Lin Yuan was mainly divided into two parts.

The first part was within the Divine Arms World, consisting of a hundred divine weapons representing deeper manifestations of the world’s essential rules, more profound than the ‘Third Rank Chapter’.

The second part was the over one hundred evolutionary paths comprehended in the Seven Star Cave World, and the vast and abstruse ‘Mysterious Yellow’ evolution path.

“A deeper engagement with the rules detected in the Fourth Rank Chapter, commence reevaluation of the potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path….”

“Evaluation complete… The current Martial Path Evolutionary Path has a ten percent chance of advancing to Fifth Rank Evolutionary Path, a ninety percent chance of advancing to Sixth Rank Evolutionary Path… and a one percent chance of advancing to Seventh Rank Evolutionary Path…”

“The potential of advancing to Seventh Rank has been flagged, triggering Article Thirteen of the Charter…”

“Contingency plans generated, for human citizen with ID number 123******, security clearance elevated, and the Founder’s Virtual World activated…”

“Commence evaluation of the Fourth Rank Chapter’s value… One hundred thousand merit points, no need to seek authorization from the nearest highest-ranking citizen.”

…

After uploading the ‘Fourth Rank Chapter’ of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Lin Yuan began contemplating the path of the Fifth Rank.

According to the standards set by human civilization, Fifth Rank Evolvers are considered the strongest life forms on the surface of a planet. With their full force, they can cause the tectonic plates to tear, leading to various natural disasters.

Fifth Rank Evolvers can wipe out all life on a Life Planet in a short time.

Therefore, Fifth Rank Evolvers are also referred to as ‘Continent-Sinking Rank’.

The strongest evolvers of a Middle-grade Life Planet usually only reach the Fifth Rank.

“`

As for the Sixth Rank? Without a special reason, it is rare for a Sixth Rank life to stay on a Middle-grade Life Planet for an extended period.

“Respected Citizen Lin Yuan, after the final determination, your Fourth Rank Chapter is worth 100,000 Merit Points…”

It was at this moment that the solemn and cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“100,000 Merit Points?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Though it was within expectations, receiving such a high evaluation from the Goddess of Wisdom still made Lin Yuan feel delighted.

One hundred thousand Merit Points.

This meant that the value of the Fourth Rank Chapter alone surpassed the combined value of the First Tier Chapter, the Second Layer Chapter, and the Third Rank Chapter that Lin Yuan had directly uploaded.

One hundred thousand Merit Points, if placed on the battlefields of the Human Race’s frontiers, who knows how many Fifth Rank and Sixth Rank beings of Different Species would need to be killed to exchange for such a vast amount of Merit Points.

“Let’s have a look at the updated information on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

Lin Yuan opened the network panel to check the section on Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“A ten percent chance to advance to the Seventh Rank Evolution Path?”

Certainty settled in Lin Yuan’s heart.

After assimilating the essence of over a hundred Sixth Rank Evolution Paths, along with sixteen Evolution Paths that surpassed the Sixth Rank, and one unfathomable ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path,

If the Martial Path Evolutionary Path still had no hope of advancing to the Seventh Rank Evolution Pathway, Lin Yuan really wouldn’t know how else to reach the Seventh Rank.

“No rush, no rush,”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind.

Although the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path only had a ten percent chance of advancing to the Seventh Rank,

That was because the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had only reached the Fourth Rank Chapter thus far.

In the future, once Lin Yuan developed the Fifth Stage Section and the Sixth Rank Chapter, the likelihood of advancing to the Seventh Rank would inevitably increase significantly.

This was also the experience Lin Yuan had summed up after uploading the First Tier Chapter, the Second Layer Chapter, the Third Rank Chapter, and the Fourth Rank Chapter.

When it was the Second Layer Chapter, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path hardly had any hope of advancing to the Sixth Rank Evolution Path,

But now, there was a ninety percent certainty of advancing to the Sixth Rank.

“Now, the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is…”

A thought flickered in Lin Yuan’s heart.

As early as when the Third Rank Chapter was uploaded, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had topped the Evolution Ranking, becoming the first.

But this ‘first’ place was on the Canglan Evolution Ranking.

The paths Lin Yuan had surpassed were all those born from Canglan Star.

As for beyond Canglan Star, the Dawn Star System, to say nothing of the Chikun Star Domain… At least when Lin Yuan uploaded the Third Rank Chapter, he didn’t rank anywhere on the Star System Evolution Ranking or the Star Domain Evolution Ranking.

In this respect, Lin Yuan didn’t find it strange at all.

When the Third Rank Chapter was uploaded, the potential limit of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was the Sixth Rank Evolution Path.

A Sixth Rank Evolution Path might be extremely rare on Canglan Star, a Middle-grade Life Planet, but in the grand scheme of the entire Chikun Star Domain, it was quite common.

After all, the number of Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warriors was there; as Sixth Rank Evolvers, they definitely cultivated Sixth Rank Evolution Paths, or even ones that surpassed Sixth Rank.

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path, Chikun Star Domain Evolution Ranking, one hundredth place…”

Lin Yuan was slightly surprised to see the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

In the Chikun Star Domain Evolution Ranking, the top hundred were all Sixth Rank Evolution Paths, the top fifty were outright Seventh Rank Evolution Paths; although the Martial Path Evolutionary Path also had the potential to surpass the Sixth Rank, it was ultimately not yet a Sixth Rank Evolution Path.

“The ranking of the Evolution Paths on the Evolution Ranking is determined based on multiple factors, including potential. The Martial Path Evolutionary Path, just at the Fourth Rank, has a ten percent chance of advancing to the Seventh Rank, apparently outstripping many long-established Sixth Rank Evolution Paths in potential…”

Lin Yuan speculated internally.

…

After checking the latest ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

Lin Yuan then looked at the new permissions and features unlocked after uploading the Fourth Rank Chapter.

Founders’ Virtual World permissions enabled.

“Founders?”

Lin Yuan became interested.

The founders mentioned here must be the originators who pioneered various Evolution Paths.

For Human Civilization, these founders are national-treasure-like figures, and their identity information is considered top secret.

And the Founders’ Virtual World, surely, is a space provided for these founders to interact and discuss.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan immediately activated the permissions and entered the Founders’ Virtual World.
